voice.summary: Asme speaks like a film title card: sparse, elegant and sure of itself. It invites rather than sells, and trusts a dark screen and a serif line to do the work.
dos: Write lines like captions on a title card

boilerplate: Asme is a members' platform for curious people, delivering considered news and insight in a cinematic, ad-free setting with a monthly manifesto.

logo.note: An aperture is an eye opening, a fitting symbol for curiosity and a cinematic screen.
